title: Rebind B139 to B167 and the current capability registry
summary: Remove B139's stale reference to the deleted B81 language-ownership lanes and its transitional F# verdict-lane statement; bind evaluation ownership and execution eligibility to B167 and the current capability registry.
origin: direct human-governor instruction 2026-10-02: B139 must bind to B167 and the current capability registry instead of the removed B81 implementation clause

changes.proposed: QUALITY-CONTROL:C++23 native training and production inference jointly own the versioned model-artifact contract inside Xingcheng;training evaluation and correctness analysis use the current registered capability contract, with ownership and eligible execution languages governed by B167 and the current capability registry;no transitional language lane is implied;BOUNDARY:concrete probes,metrics,datasets and thresholds are Xingcheng owner-local rules;ACCEPTANCE:current native evidence must establish the shipped architecture's declared health invariants - for routed/sparse designs that includes routing balance,expert utilization and non-collapse - plus gradient coverage,artifact integrity and inference compatibility before promotion;FAILURE:missing,stale,unregistered or contradictory evidence denies promotion.
